measurement_and_scientific_value.useful_future_question: An authenticated EMC per-cell assay could inform whether bulk CSPG4 arises from malignant cells or admixed stromal/pericyte/smooth-muscle compartments and guide cell-specific protein testing. This remains conditional, not a new finding or biological absence.
measurement_and_scientific_value.strongest_alternative: Different histology or unlinked pathology, mixture/dissociation, ambientRNA/doublets, low gene capture and cell identity inferred only from CNA/embedding. A gene symbol, generic sarcoma label, filename or shared code cannot authenticate EMC.
measurement_and_scientific_value.if_reopened: Before outcomes, freeze all eligible EMC donors/conditions, controls, gene/annotation mapping and cell-class assignment; assess capture/dropout and ambient/doublet/mixture sensitivity. Preserve all cell categories and no-detection conditions, donor overlap and assay limitations; RNA does not establish surface protein, accessible epitope, efficacy or safety. Complete all relevant public EMC measurements and primary localization prior art before promotion.
measurement_and_scientific_value.novelty_value: Published quality/stress metrics and new source-availability clarification do not themselves add an EMC compartment measurement. Submitted-letter compartment rationale does not substitute for patient identity or analyzable data. No useful new publication-worthy finding survives this bounded gate.
